name: helios-game-engine
description: Create, develop, simulate and play games with Helios through ChatGPT Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Build and play games in chat
interface.longDescription: Develop playable 2D roguelike, sandbox, platformer and top-down game prototypes, plus retro FPS levels and AI agent simulations. Tools run a bundled local Python MCP process. Requires Python 3.10+ on your computer. Does not provide an in-chat real-time 3D renderer.
defaultPrompt: Create a procedural roguelike game using Helios.
Play a platformer in Helios and show the map.
Create a Doom-style level using Helios.
